probes.check: Tracy's own link-time check: code compiled with other TRACY_* options than the client references tracy::GetProfiler and tracy::GetToken under other names, the link fails, and verify reads the missing symbol from the build log as ABI_DEFINE_MISMATCH(tracy).

seeded_violation.description: Define TRACY_FIBERS for the glue in Tracy's build fragment, while the tracy port builds the client without fibers support in either variant.

adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(Tracy CONFIG REQUIRED) and links Tracy::TracyClient; its headers are included as <tracy/Tracy.hpp>.

The client starts with the process. In the default variant it keeps what it records in memory until a profiler connects: a long run with no profiler attached grows without bound, so that variant is for development builds. The on-demand variant records only while a profiler is connected and can ship; every translation unit gets TRACY_ON_DEMAND from Tracy::TracyClient, and mixing the two fails at link time. Both listen on the network for a profiler.
Game code may use Tracy's own macros (ZoneScoped, FrameMark) alongside the facade's zones; both reach the same client.
